WITH

dense AS (SELECT NULL::bigint AS id, NULL::float8 AS sim, NULL::bigint AS dense_rank WHERE $1::halfvec IS NOT NULL AND false),

sparse AS (
  SELECT id,
         ts_rank_cd(search_tsv, to_tsquery('simple', $2)) AS lex,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts_rank_cd(search_tsv, to_tsquery('simple', $2)) DESC) AS sparse_rank
  FROM entries
  WHERE search_tsv @@ to_tsquery('simple', $2)
    AND NOT (entries.is_root = 0 AND entries.chunk_root IS NOT DISTINCT FROM entries.id AND entries.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'archived')
    
  ORDER BY lex DESC
  LIMIT $4
),

trgm AS (
  SELECT id,
         1.0::float8 AS trg_sim,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts DESC) AS trgm_rank
  FROM entries
  WHERE (
      content ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'
      OR (element ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR (element IS NULL AND '' ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'))
      OR (summary ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%' OR (summary IS NULL AND '' ILIKE '%' || $3 || '%'))
    )
    AND NOT (entries.is_root = 0 AND entries.chunk_root IS NOT DISTINCT FROM entries.id AND entries.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'archived')
    
    AND id >= (SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) - 200000, 0) FROM entries)
  ORDER BY ts DESC
  LIMIT $4
),

exact_matches AS (
  SELECT ee.id,
         ee.ts,
         q.term,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY q.term)::float8 AS term_df
  FROM entries ee
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT lower(ee.content) AS content, lower(ee.element) AS element, lower(ee.summary) AS summary
    OFFSET 0
  ) lc
  JOIN LATERAL unnest($5::text[]) AS q(term) ON (
       strpos(lc.content, q.term) > 0
       OR strpos(lc.element, q.term) > 0
       OR strpos(lc.summary, q.term) > 0
  )
  WHERE true
    AND NOT (ee.is_root = 0 AND ee.chunk_root IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ee.id AND ee.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'archived')
    
    AND ee.id >= (SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) - 200000, 0) FROM entries)
),
exact AS (
  SELECT id,
         COUNT(*)::float8 AS exact_hits,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE POSITION(' ' IN term) > 0)::float8 AS exact_phrase_hits,
         SUM(
           (CASE WHEN term ~ '[A-Za-z0-9_./:-]' THEN 3.0 ELSE 1.0 END)
           / SQRT(GREATEST(term_df, 1))
         )::float8 AS exact_rarity,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           ORDER BY SUM(
                      (CASE WHEN term ~ '[A-Za-z0-9_./:-]' THEN 3.0 ELSE 1.0 END)
                      / SQRT(GREATEST(term_df, 1))
                    ) DESC,
                    COUNT(*) DESC,
                    MAX(ts) DESC
         ) AS exact_rank
  FROM exact_matches
  GROUP BY id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
  ORDER BY exact_rarity DESC, exact_hits DESC, MAX(ts) DESC
  LIMIT $4
),
combined AS (
  SELECT id FROM dense  WHERE id IS NOT NULL UNION
  SELECT id FROM sparse WHERE id IS NOT NULL UNION
  SELECT id FROM trgm   WHERE id IS NOT NULL UNION
  SELECT id FROM exact  WHERE id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  e.id, e.element, e.summary, e.category, e.status, e.score,
  e.last_seen_at, e.ts, e.project_id, e.session_id, e.source_ref,
  e.source_turn, e.content, e.chunk_root, e.concept_id, e.supersedes_id, e.is_root,
  e.role,
  d.sim        AS dense_sim,
  d.dense_rank,
  s.lex        AS sparse_lex,
  s.sparse_rank,
  t.trg_sim,
  t.trgm_rank,
  x.exact_hits,
  x.exact_phrase_hits,
  x.exact_rarity,
  x.exact_rank
FROM combined c
JOIN   entries e ON e.id = c.id
LEFT JOIN dense  d ON d.id = c.id
LEFT JOIN sparse s ON s.id = c.id
LEFT JOIN trgm   t ON t.id = c.id
LEFT JOIN exact  x ON x.id = c.id
